channel.title: Persistent Volume Claim on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Persistent Volume Claim on KubeSphere

item.title: Create a PersistentVolumeClaim
item.description: This section describes how to create a PersistentVolumeClaim. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the PersistentVolumeClaim Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has PersistentVolumeClaim Management permissions and enter your workspace. Click Storage > PersistentVolumeClaims in the left navigation pane.

item.title: View Persistent Volume Claim List
item.description: This section describes how to view the list of persistent volume claims. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Persistent Volume Claim View permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Persistent Volume Claim View permissions and enter your workspace. Click Storage > Persistent Volume Claims in the left navigation pane.

item.title: View Persistent Volume Claim Details
item.description: This section describes how to view persistent volume claim details. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Persistent Volume Claim View permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Persistent Volume Claim View permissions and enter your workspace. Click Storage > Persistent Volume Claims in the left navigation pane.

item.title: Clone a Persistent Volume Claim
item.description: This section describes how to clone a PersistentVolumeClaim. After a PersistentVolumeClaim and a PersistentVolume are created, you can create identical copies for the PersistentVolumeClaim and the PersistentVolume respectively by cloning. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Persistent Volume Claim Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Ensure that the system has created a persistent volume for the persistent volume claim.

item.title: Expand Persistent Volume Claim
item.description: This section describes how to expand the volume capacity of a PersistentVolumeClaim. The capacity of the bound PersistentVolume will also be expanded accordingly. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Persistent Volume Claim Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Ensure that the system has created a persistent volume for the persistent volume claim.

item.title: Edit Persistent Volume Claim Information
item.description: This section describes how to edit the basic information of a PersistentVolumeClaim. You can edit the alias and description of a PersistentVolumeClaim. KubeSphere does not support editing the name of a PersistentVolumeClaim. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Persistent Volume Claim Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Persistent Volume Claim Management permissions and enter your workspace.

item.title: Delete Persistent Volume Claim
item.description: This section describes how to delete a PersistentVolumeClaim. Warning A PersistentVolumeClaim cannot be recovered after deletion, and by default, the corresponding PersistentVolume will also be deleted. Please perform this operation with caution to avoid data loss. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Persistent Volume Claim Management permission in the project.
